format:
  gfm: default
  md: default

_quarto:
  tests:
    gfm:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['``` mermaid', '``` geojson', '``` topojson', '``` stl', '``` plantuml', '``` math', '``` quarto-test-language', '``` text', '``` python', '``` explicit-language']
        - ['language-language-']
    md:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['``` mermaid', '``` geojson', '``` topojson', '``` stl', '``` plantuml', '``` math', '``` quarto-test-language', '``` text', '``` python', '``` explicit-language']
        - ['language-language-']
    markdown:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['\.quarto-test-language', '\.extra-class']
        - ['language-quarto-test-language']
